title: Post-release public status lock

context.summary: Lock public status after a successful v0.1.1 release and final gate.
context.background: Once v0.1.1 is live and accepted, repository docs must point users at the exact release URL and supported commands.

in: Update repository status, README, support matrix and release checklist with the exact v0.1.1 release URL.
Document known limits and supported multimodal status after final gate success.
Document user commands for install, local run, UI, CLI, MCP and uninstall.
Verify CI and local checks are green.

acceptance_criteria: Public docs identify v0.1.1 as the current usable pre-release.
No public doc claims v0.1.0 is the current release.
Known limits are explicit and do not downgrade supported v0.1.1 paths.
pnpm check and CI are green.

manual_checks: Confirm the release URL resolves publicly.
Confirm git status is clean before final response.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
